EmployeeSchedule.title: EmployeeSchedule
EmployeeSchedule.description: Monthly work schedule for a single employee, published by the supervisor and searchable by employee name without storing PII.

monthKey.description: Target year and month in YYYY-MM format.

employeeName.description: Employee display name used for schedule lookup.

normalizedName.description: Lowercase accent-stripped name for case-insensitive search.

days.description: Map of day keys (01..31) to status codes (T, F, FE, FR, A).

isPublished.description: Whether this schedule is published for employee consultation.

updatedBy.description: UID of the supervisor who created or last updated the schedule.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the schedule document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the schedule document was last updated.

SupervisorAdmin.title: SupervisorAdmin
SupervisorAdmin.description: Authorized supervisor document granting schedule management access.

createdBy.description: UID of the bootstrapped admin who added this supervisor.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/schedules/{scheduleId}.description: Monthly employee schedules indexed by monthKey and employee slug (e.g. 2026-11_maria-silva). Published schedules contain no PII and are readable by employees; only verified supervisors may write.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Authorized supervisor accounts allowed to create, import, edit, and delete employee schedules.
